{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm 'loyal' is a valid segment — yes, from prior check
# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check if any QA orders are in this group
qa_in_loyal = loyal_completed[loyal_completed['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print("QA orders in loyal/completed group:", len(qa_in_loyal))

# Now, parse revenue as float after removing commas
loyal_completed['revenue_float'] = loyal_completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_float'].mean()

print("Number of loyal completed orders:", len(loyal_completed))
print("Mean revenue (USD):", mean_revenue)"}
